name: citrus_engine_error_count
description: Count of ERROR-severity structured-log lines from the citrus-draft-engine container. The gcplogs driver ships every line with severity=DEFAULT, so the live match is the text form `"severity":"ERROR"` inside jsonPayload.message (packages/shared/src/utils/structuredLogger.ts writes the GCP-canonical name with no whitespace); `severity>=ERROR` is kept for a future agent that parses the JSON. Label `event` is the structured-logger discriminator (e.g. event_subscription.fetch_failed) so an alert names the failing path. Managed by infra/gcp/monitoring/apply-monitoring.sh.

labels.description: structuredLogger `event` discriminator extracted from the raw JSON line (bounded by the engine's event taxonomy, runbook §8.2).
Docker label `environment` forwarded by the gcplogs driver (production / staging).
